content: Dr. Adair is affiliated with an institution at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill in the United States. This institution received funding from Wyeth in 2012 and again during the period from 2012 to 2014. Wyeth was subsequently acquired by Nestlé in 2013. However, Dr. Adair did not personally receive any funds, either for herself or for her research activities. Brien André, who is retired and formerly affiliated with the University of Tampere in Finland, has declared no conflicts of interest. Suzanne Farhoud, who previously served as a Regional Adviser for Child and Adolescent Health at the World Health Organization's Regional Office for the Eastern Mediterranean, has declared no conflicts of interest. Rukhsana Haider, associated with the World Alliance for Breastfeeding Action and the Training and Assistance for Health and Nutrition (THAN) Foundation, has declared no conflicts of interest. Alan Jackson, affiliated with the University of Southampton in the United Kingdom, has declared no conflicts of interest. Zein Karrar, affiliated with the University of Khartoum in Sudan, has declared no conflicts of interest. Cecilia Martinez-Costa, affiliated with the University of Valencia in Spain, has declared no conflicts of interest. John Reilly, affiliated with the University of Strathclyde in the United Kingdom, has declared a conflict of interest.
